name: Dilemmas
description: Philosophical and ethical dilemmas with no right answer.

dilemas-te-dan-mal-el-cambio-a-tu.text: You're given too much change (10 euros extra) and you notice. Do you say something?
options: Yes, I always give it back
Depends: a big chain, I keep quiet; a small shop, I say so
I keep quiet and pocket it, whoever it is

dilemas-puedes-salvar-a-5-desconocidos-o.text: You can save 5 strangers or 1 loved one. Who do you save?

dilemas-mentirias-a-un-amigo-para-no-hac.text: Would you lie to a friend to avoid hurting them?

dilemas-el-fin-justifica-los-medios.text: Does the end justify the means?
options: Yes, if the result is good

dilemas-que-vida-prefieres.text: Which life would you rather have?
options: Short but intense, leaving a mark
Long and quiet, no highs or lows

dilemas-saber-que-hay-tras-la-muerte-per.text: Know what comes after death but never be able to tell anyone, or never know at all?

dilemas-un-tren-va-a-atropellar-a-5.text: A train is about to run over 5 people. You can switch it to another track where there's only 1. Do you pull the lever?
options: Yes, I switch it (1 dies, 5 live)

dilemas-solo-puedes-salvar-a-5-desconoci.text: The only way to save 5 strangers is to push another stranger onto the train tracks yourself. Do you push?

dilemas-te-ofrecen-enchufarte-para-siemp.text: You're offered to be plugged forever into a machine that simulates a perfect life, and you'd never know it's fake. Do you go in?
options: Yes, give me the perfect life
No, I'd rather have reality, even if it hurts

dilemas-viajas-al-pasado-y-tienes-delant.text: You travel back in time and baby Hitler is right in front of you. Do you kill him?
